paper.title_en: The matter creation cosmology: A kinetic approach
paper.abstract_en: The action of dissipative mechanisms described in flat FLRW geometry is associated with the manifestation of negative pressure terms, capable of causally justifying the dynamical regime of the Cosmos (accelerated expansion) without the need to consider the presence/action of any dark energy term (i.e. thus reducing the “dark sector”). The only two dissipative mechanisms possibly arising in the metric in question are the (cosmics) bulk viscosity and matter creation. In this paper, we will consider the gravitationally induced creation of particles by the Universe expansion as the only (concomitant with the expansion) energetic mechanism present in the Cosmos. The original result presented in this work consists in the obtaining, via microscopic (kinetic) formulation, of a new possible form for the rate of matter creation.
